title: 壁付け雨どい縦管
description: 中空の連続管、上部オフセット、開いた吐出口、継手と壁面支持金具を備えた雨どい縦管。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A hollow rainwater pipe with smooth upper offset, open discharge elbow, coupling collars and wall stand-off clamps. Decorative building equipment. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
